subject: Bible (KJV) Genesis 1:1-3
content: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters. And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

subject: Bible (KJV) Psalm 23:1-4
content: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake. Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

subject: Bible (KJV) John 3:16
content: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

subject: Bible (KJV) Matthew 5:3-9
content: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted. Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth. Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled. Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy. Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God. Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

subject: Bible (KJV) Exodus 20:3-7
content: Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image... Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain...

subject: Quran study note: Al-Fatiha theme
content: Opening chapter themes: praise of God, guidance on the straight path, mercy and judgment — study full Arabic and trusted translations for worship. (Educational summary — not a substitute for a complete mushaf or certified translation.)

subject: Quran study note: Knowledge & reflection

subject: Quran study note: Ethics
content: Core ethical themes across many verses include justice, kindness to parents, honesty in trade, and care for the needy. (Educational summary — not a substitute for a complete mushaf or certified translation.)

subject: Gnostic study note
content: Gnosticism historically refers to diverse early movements emphasizing hidden knowledge (gnosis), often distinguishing spirit and material world. Texts like parts of the Nag Hammadi library are studied academically. Educational only.

content: An optical transceiver converts electrical signals to optical (and back) for fiber links. Common form factors: SFP, SFP+, QSFP, QSFP28. Key specs: wavelength (e.g. 1310nm, 1550nm), data rate, reach, connector type (LC), and whether single-mode or multi-mode fiber.

subject: Fiber optic communication
content: Uses light in glass fiber for high bandwidth and low loss. Single-mode for long distance; multi-mode for shorter runs. Infrastructure includes patch panels, ODFs, media converters, and optical transceivers in switches/routers.

subject: SFP module
content: Small Form-factor Pluggable transceiver hot-swappable in network equipment. Match fiber type and wavelength. DOM/DDM may report temperature and optical power.

subject: Wavelength division multiplexing
content: WDM combines multiple wavelengths on one fiber to multiply capacity. CWDM and DWDM used in metro and long-haul networks.
